t: The Passive FE Power Port allows you to insert and extract energy from the Energizer.$(br2)Any Forge Energy-compatible cable or machine can be connected to the Passive FE Power Port. The connected block must extract or insert energy on its own.
被动 FE 能量端口可以让你向充能器输入和从中提取能量。$(br2)任何兼容 Forge 能量的线缆或机器都可以连接到被动 FE 能量端口。连接的方块必须自行提取或输入能量。
$(l)Mandatory:$() no$(br)$(l)Valid positions:$() any face (not on frame)$(br)$(l)Graphical interface:$() yes
